responsibility: Managed Agent integration identities and the bounded, language-neutral operation request and report contract exchanged by native Clients, the Server relay, and the node-local writer. Actual consumers are orchbee-agent-integration-writer, which executes the contract on a node, orchbee-workbench-client, which re-exports the contract values, and orchbee-workbench-protocol, which embeds the documents in the Workbench Agent integration direction.
nonGoals: Executing inspections or mutations, changing provider configuration, owning threads, processes, cancellation, or deadlines, authorization, transport framing, rendering, or CLI grammar.
Defining Desktop's TypeScript integration writer, the Agent observation contract, or the provider registry itself.
